method.data: trades_raw 2026-11-10, 51 symbols (config/mm_multi.yaml + BTCUSDT); orders = same-ms same-side prints merged (C1); FIT = 00-12 UTC, TEST = 12-24 UTC; flow_3s TEST half for the real facts (12-24 UTC; 6.3k-9.9k ok 3 s candles per symbol, gaps never filled); flow_3s 2026-11-07..09 (before TEST) for spread / depth / tick regime; C1 FIT-half laws for sizes, signs, prints per order
method.classes: major = BTC ETH SOL XRP DOGE; tradfi = CL BZ XAU XAG QQQ NVDA TSLA MSTR COIN CRWV GOOGL; alt = the rest (incl. BNB) (MS block)
method.W: W = sigma_day x P V_day from FIT trades: sigma_day = std of 1-min log returns of the trade mid proxy ((last buy + last sell) / 2) x sqrt(1440); P V_day = 2 x FIT notional (USD); illiquidity 1/L = (sigma_day^2 / P V_day)^(1/3) (Kyle-Obizhaeva 2016)
method.parameters: per symbol, FIT half: log orders/s (rate); deseasonalised expmix3 duration weights and log component means (mean-1 units); order size tail zeta (C1 size.order) and log-normal body mu, sigma; order sign gamma (C1 signs.order.acf_power) and lag-1 ACF; log median relative spread (bp, pre-TEST flow_3s TWA) of all symbols; tick regime (logistic on log tick/price and log W); log Kyle lambda = OLS slope of 1 s trade-mid-proxy log return (bp) on 1 s signed notional (USD 1k) (trade-price slope reported)
method.H-MS7: OLS of each parameter on [1, log W, alt, tradfi] over the 51 symbols; leave-one-symbol-out R^2 = 1 - PRESS / TSS; 95% CI and p = P*(R2_LOO <= 0.5) by a bootstrap over symbols (B = 2000; LOO on the resample with all copies of the held-out symbol dropped); universality of zeta (order size tail) and gamma (order sign ACF): D = Var((F+T)/2) / (Var(F-T)/4) across symbols (F, T = FIT and TEST estimates; D = 1 when the between-symbol spread is all estimation noise; D > 1 iff the halves covary), p_disp = bootstrap P*(D <= 1); supports = LOO R^2 > 0.5 for rate, spread and impact AND p_disp >= 0.05 for zeta and gamma, with Holm p < 0.05; summary p = max of the three R^2 bootstrap p values; criterion met with Holm p >= 0.05 -> inconclusive; not met -> contradicts
method.v1: sim/flow_sim_v1.py fitted per symbol on FIT: intensity two-component AR of log order counts (bins with mean >= 10 orders), expmix3 on durations x local rate (centered 5-bin window) rescaled to mean 1, C1 size law (capped at the FIT maximum order), C1 TranslatedSignModel with p_buy = 0.5 (no drift), prints-per-order pmf rank-coupled to notional (FIT Spearman), square-root impact per order with permanent share g_inf = 0.6 and tau = 30 s (fixed, not fitted), noise variance prop. to activity, jumps from FIT 1-min exceedances (> 6 robust sd), spread latent AR(1) in log ticks censored at 1 tick (pre-TEST flow_3s quantiles, 3 s lag-1 ACF), elasticity 0.07 to log activity; k_imp, sigma0 and jump rate by indirect inference (2 pilots x 4 h, 5 iterations) so that the same trade-based estimators on simulated trades match FIT lambda, 1-min sigma and exceedance rate
method.H-MS8: facts as H-SIM2 (excess kurtosis of 3 s mid returns, mean ACF |r| lags 1-60, mean ACF signed flow lags 1-20, corr(r_t, F_t), spread median AND p90) on the TEST half; envelope = [2.5%, 97.5%] of the class median under a 1 h block bootstrap of each symbol's TEST facts (B = 300), the v0 method on one period; sim value = class median over symbols of each symbol's median over 10 paths of the symbol's TEST ok-candle count; v0 = the H-SIM2 FlowSim models (fitted 2026-11-08/09) with the same path count; supports = v1 count > v0 count in every class and v1 >= 4/5 for majors, with Holm p < 0.05; p = share of 1000 symbol-bootstrap replicates (resampling symbols within class for envelope and sims together) where the criterion fails; level-vs-shape: v1 refitted with the TEST levels (order rate, 1-min sigma, lambda, spread location) as an oracle diagnostic
method.holm: Holm over H-MS7 and H-MS8 (the registered family is the whole MS block; the block-wide adjustment with the other recorded MS p values is reported)
method.replay: descriptive only (H-SIM4 / H-MM3 are the registered tests): sim.replay run_mm with the H-SIM1 touch fill model, decisions every 9 s, real = flow_3s TEST half of the 50 mm_multi symbols, v1 = 3 paths per symbol (5 h warm-up + TEST length), 3 fill seeds; sets: live config/mm_multi.yaml and the replay-best a0.2_b0.9_tp0.9_rq0.15 (plus the 36-set grid for a rank comparison)
